Origin Residences Phuket Bangtao

Кондоминиум — Bang Tao (Soi Bang Tao 42, Cherng Talay)
ГлавнаяПродажаOrigin Residences Phuket Bangtao

Developer marketing renders (artist impressions). Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

О проекте

Origin Residences Phuket Bangtao is a low-rise condominium by Origin Property, a Bangkok-listed developer, on Soi Bang Tao 42 behind Andaman Riviera, about 400 m from Bang Tao Beach. It has 294 units in three seven-storey buildings over a basement, on about 4 rai of land. It is a separate project from Origin's larger So Origin Bangtao Beach.

The layouts are simple: one-bedroom residences of about 40 sqm, two-bedroom suites of about 60 sqm and two-bedroom penthouses of about 86 sqm. Facilities include a sky pool and pool bar, a spa zone with heated and cold pools, sauna and steam room, a gym, co-working space, a pet lounge and a shuttle service. Agents note that parking covers only about 45% of units.

Boat Avenue is about 2.6 km away and Laguna Golf about 5 km. Completion is planned for Q3 2028. Foreign buyers are offered leasehold, with freehold for Thai buyers.

Origin Residences Phuket Bangtao: ключевые факты

  • Origin Residences Phuket Bangtao — low-rise resort condominium в Банг Тао, Пхукет, застройщик: Origin Property PCL.
  • Юниты: 1–2 спальни, 40.2–85.85 м².
  • Статус строительства: предпродажа; срок завершения: 3 кв. 2028.
  • Форма собственности по данным источников: Лизхолд (Leasehold) — долгосрочная аренда.
  • Заявленная стартовая цена: 5 000 000 ฿.
  • Ближайший пляж: Пляж Банг Тао (400 м).
  • Рядом, по данным проекта: Пляж Банг Тао (400 м); Boat Avenue (2,6 км, по прямой); Пляж Сурин (2,9 км, по прямой); Blue Tree Phuket (3,8 км, по прямой).
  • Другие проекты застройщика Origin Property в нашем каталоге: The Origin Kathu-Patong, So Origin Kata Phuket.
